citeAs: Li, X., Wang, Y., Yu, J., Zeng, X., Zhu, Y., Huang, H., Gao, J., Li, K., He, Y., Wang, C., Qiao, Y., Wang, Y., & Wang, L. (2025). VideoChat-Flash: Hierarchical Compression for Long-Context Video Modeling. arXiv preprint arXiv:2501.00574.
creator: Xinhao Li, Yi Wang, Jiashuo Yu, Xiangyu Zeng, Yuhan Zhu, Haian Huang, Jianfei Gao, Kunchang Li, Yinan He, Chenting Wang, Yu Qiao, Yali Wang, Limin Wang (Shanghai AI Laboratory, Nanjing University, Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, Shanghai Innovation Institute)
description: A large-scale long video instruction-tuning dataset comprising 114,228 long videos and 3,444,849 question-answering (QA) pairs across five different task types.
name: LongVid
rai:dataCollection: Constructed by leveraging existing datasets (Ego4D, HowTo100M, HD-VILA, MiraData). Dense event labels were generated using existing high-quality short video captions, and QA pairs were constructed based on video captions, event labels, and timestamps.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Existing datasets including Ego4D, HowTo100M, HD-VILA, and MiraData, encompassing movies, egocentric videos, news, interviews, and how-to videos.
rai:dataUseCases: Training multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for long video understanding and instruction following.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: LLMs (e.g., Qwen-72b) were used to extract major events from captions.
